reuse.why: Two small shared guards are called from every link handler, but the takeover rewrites unlinkAccount's field reset and Fintegra re-creates the per-provider link and download bodies instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount repeats the Akahu/SimpleFin link body, downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the Akahu download, and the replace branch repeats unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount block.

placement.why: Guards live beside the link handlers in accounts/app.ts, the download in sync.ts and the URL in server-config.ts, following the tree's layout.

scope.why: The change sticks to linking, Fintegra and tests for the new rules; nothing unrelated is touched.

maintainability.why: Separate open-account and not-linked guards are easy to follow, but a mutating 'ensure…' helper and another hand-copied provider pair add upkeep.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/app.ts clears the previous holder with its own db.updateAccount instead of reusing unlinkAccount's unlink step

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions and linkFintegraAccount are compacted/reformatted versions of the Akahu download and link functions (destructured response, one-line guards) rather than shared code

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains a replaceExistingLink flag and a detach branch; the closed rule is a separate helper and every link handler calls both
